newsitem.title: USA: ITI's largest customer cuts back orders.
newsitem.headline: ITI's largest customer cuts back orders.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said Friday that ADT Security Systems Inc, its single largest customer, said it will reduce purchase orders during the first quarter of 1997.

ITI said it received a letter on Thursday from ADT, stating that ITI is currently not in ADT's "future strategic product planning." No specific reasons were given by ADT for the change in its product strategy.
ITI said the significant reduction of orders from ADT will have a material adverse effect on its revenues and earnings in 1997.

ITI, which designs and makes wireless security systems sold by a direct sales force to independent dealers in the United States and Canada, said ADT accounted for more than 43 percent of its revenues through the third quarter of 1996.

Management has long recognized that having one customer account for such a large portion of our sales represented a business risk, ITI said. Accordingly, it said it has been working on several new product developments and seeking sales opportunities with a number of other potentially large customers.
ITI said it believes these efforts, coupled with a strong financial position, will allow it to continue to prosper.
